scope: AI Routing Stage 4 data-governance residuals and material/process suitability evidence
principles: The locked U8 truth route is the reliable evaluation baseline for these four parts.
Part process depends on the raw material and stock/material suitability, not only on part shape or a generic sheet/plate tag.
Sheet/plate-like geometry does not automatically authorize laser cutting.
Compound names containing 板 can describe the parent object rather than the part class, for example 推板连接杆 means connecting rod for the push plate.

findings.humanFinding: Sheet/plate-type part, but raw material is not suitable for laser cutting; U8 route without laser is correct.
findings.extractionIssue: laser process hint is a false positive if inferred from sheet/plate evidence alone
findings.routeGenerationImplication: do not add laser; use this as a negative guardrail for sheet-like but laser-unsuitable material/stock
findings.trainingCoverageNeed: coherent non-Evaluation Training coverage remains needed for mill -> machining-center -> tap -> oxidation if source-reviewed and approved
